Sounds of the meadow

Real recordings and openly licensed music. Music and sound effects have separate switches in the game. Your browser may need a click on Start before audio can play.

Sheep baa

“Sheep baaing 1 – Norwegian sheep expressing itself concisely” by Michael Perfect (michaelperfect). A genuine sheep field recording.

Original recording on Freesound · CC0 1.0 Public Domain Dedication

Public high-quality MP3 preview, unchanged. Courtesy attribution; CC0 does not require it.

Chomp

“Apple Bite” by phatcorns. A real apple-bite recording used for the sheep’s cartoon chomp.

Original recording on Freesound · CC0 1.0 Public Domain Dedication

Public high-quality MP3 preview, unchanged. Courtesy attribution.

Meadow music

“Dream Culture” by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com).
Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License.

Track and creator · CC BY 4.0 license

ISRC USUAN1300046. Piano and percussion; 70 BPM. Re-encoded to 96 kbps / 32 kHz MP3 for browser delivery, played at a quiet volume, and repeated with its natural quiet ending. Cartoon knockout

An original two-note synthesized “wah-wah”, generated by the game with Web Audio. No sampled recording or third-party music is used for this effect.

Dragon fire

“flamewind.wav” by scarbelly25. Source recording · CC0 1.0. Adapted from the public high-quality MP3 preview, shortened to a 0.75-second burst, faded, lowered in volume and re-encoded at 96 kbps / 32 kHz.

Dragon boss music

“Video Dungeon Boss” by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com). Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License. Track and creator · CC BY 4.0. A 30-second excerpt was faded, lowered in volume and re-encoded for the timed dragon encounter. No creator endorsement implied.
